claims.claim: A Python set is an unordered collection of distinct hashable objects.
Sets support membership testing and mathematical operations including union, intersection, and difference.
Sets do not record element position or insertion order and do not support indexing or slicing.
An empty Python set is created with set(), while {} creates an empty dictionary.
set is mutable and unhashable; frozenset is immutable and hashable.
Converting a sequence with set() eliminates duplicate elements.
